# Example Program 3 — High School Football Player (4-Week Block, In-Season/Competitive Prep, Testing Week 3, Deload Week 4)

*Raw program as written by the coach. Preserved as-written to serve as a few-shot example for AI program generation — do not edit for "correctness," only to fix transcription errors. Sport is football, not ultimate, but included because it demonstrates the coach's structural conventions at a different level of complexity: daily activation circuit, day-specific training emphasis in the title, AM/PM session splits, built-in testing, and an explicit deload week.*

**Notation key (inferred from the sheet):**
- Circuit numbering (`1a`, `1b`, `1c`...) = exercises grouped/paired within a block
- Each day's title names its emphasis (e.g., "Bilat Power, Full Body Endurance/Hypertrophy (emphasize unilateral)")
- Week 4 across the board is explicitly labeled `DELOAD`
- Week 3 in several places is a built-in test (e.g., "Broad jump test," "L drill," rep-max cluster sets)
- Cue column mixes literal cues and shorthand exercise notes (e.g., "Weighted squat jump" appears as a cue on Trap Bar Deadlift — likely meant as a superset/pairing note)
